Follow for truths that actually help you grow
caption:
Discipline and self improvement mean nothing without understanding attraction. These 8 harsh truths about loyalty will change your mindset forever.

You've been told your whole life that loyalty is the answer. Be faithful. Be patient. Be there. Those things matter. But by themselves they're not enough. Loyalty without excitement is just furniture. She sees it. She respects it. But she doesn't feel anything.

What she responds to changes depending on her stage of life. Sometimes she wants fire and adventure. Sometimes she wants calm and commitment. If you only know how to be one you'll always be the wrong man at the wrong time.

These 8 truths will sting. They should. The men who hear them and adjust will stop losing. The ones who argue will stay exactly where they are.

Read every slide. Save this. Decide which type of man you want to be.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
